definitions.gloss: Kobe; the port city of Hyogo Prefecture
definitions.explanation: A major port city west of Osaka, wedged between mountains and the sea. Opened to foreign trade in 1868, it kept a cosmopolitan reputation for Western architecture, bakeries, and coffee, and it is also the source of {神戸|こうべ}{牛|ぎゅう} beef.

{神戸|こうべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜景|やけい}→夜景：10434_yakei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The night view of Kobe is very famous.

examples.english: Because the mountains and sea are close together in Kobe, it has become a town full of slopes.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {神戸|こうべ}{牛|ぎゅう}: Kobe beef, the premium marbled beef brand
- {神戸|こうべ}{港|こう}: the Port of Kobe
- ⟦{異人館|いじんかん}→異人館：30716_ijinkan⟧: the Western-style residences of the old foreign settlement
- {阪神|はんしん}{淡路|あわじ}{大震災|だいしんさい}: the 1995 Great Hanshin earthquake, which devastated the city

CULTURAL NOTE:
{神戸|こうべ} carries an image of refinement and Western influence — {神戸|こうべ}{風|ふう} suggests stylish, slightly European taste, especially in sweets and fashion. Its recovery from the 1995 earthquake is also a standard reference point in discussions of disaster preparedness.
